decisions.summary: Accept the frozen closed-form API Spine work package, deterministic admission, one-request checkpoint and complete preexecution controls.
Accept one consumed native process, one completed provider request, one edit call/result, zero changed paths, zero retries and complete cleanup.
Reject useful-worker success, candidate adoption and broad DeepSeek or Harness reliability claims because no candidate exists.
Accept the passing post-terminal command ledger, persisted terminal schema, zero owned processes and exact root absence.
Accept seven contained or escalated workflow and occupied-attempt observations with no open incident and no retry authority.

claim_scope: The installed native Harness reached stock-headless HMR, the custom runner and one completed DeepSeek provider request.
The runner observed one edit tool call and one tool result but no concluded turn, changed path or candidate.
The broker contained a later request at the one-request ceiling and all retry, resume, fallback and auxiliary-model counts remained zero.
Harness, broker and disposable root cleanup is complete and no raw sensitive runtime artifact is retained.
The clockwork improved containment and traceability but useful worker efficacy remains unproved.
No ordinary-practice, product, data, production, deployment, release, Pages or protected-ref authority opened.
unresolved_gates: The edit tool-result/post-execute conclusion cause is not distinguished by the retained typed terminal.
No useful runbook candidate or native-Harness useful-worker success exists.
The consumed attempt cannot be retried or resumed and no new occupied worker is authorised.
The admission-readiness runbook, observability and operational-evidence gaps remain open.
Ordinary practice, product data, production, deployment, release, Pages and protected integration remain closed.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Git identities in Ariadne runtime source evidence must be generated by the machine snapshot and never restated in hand-authored Git-ref prose.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first preplanning receipt rejected git_refs_and_worktree prose because it manually restated Git object identities.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The Ariadne receipt builder returned revision_required before worker preparation or provider execution.

correction.action: Remove manually stated Git identities from source prose and use only the builder's machine-resolved snapshot.
correction.prevention_control: Keep git_refs_and_worktree descriptive and require all full object identities to originate in the receipt builder's typed Git snapshot.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the rejected manual Git-ref prose and reinforces machine-only full-object resolution.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The preparation controller must consume the validation runner's actual typed receipt without a hand-written compatibility artifact.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first controller expected obsolete direct head_before, head_after and dirty_after fields instead of the validation runner's hashed command ledger.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pre-preparation source inspection compared the controller contract with the passed validation receipt and found the incompatible shape before dispatch.

correction.action: Validate the exact command manifest and results, bind the tracked-clean command and machine-resolve the full source object from its stdout digest.
correction.prevention_control: Consumer tests must exercise the persisted validation-runner receipt schema directly and reject digest, command or result drift.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: binds preparation directly to the validation runner's hashed command ledger and full machine-resolved source.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A clockwork checkpoint may descend from the reviewed candidate only through the exact immutable review-receipt commit and no product or control delta.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first rule required literal equality between reviewed candidate and checkpoint source, making its own committed review receipt impossible to bind.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Prepublication source comparison showed that the clockwork would resolve the one-receipt descendant and the controller would reject it.

correction.action: Admit only an ancestor relation whose exact changed-path list contains the named review receipt and nothing else.
correction.prevention_control: Checkpoint source validation must separate reviewed semantic source from its single evidence-only receipt descendant and fail every other delta.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: permits exactly one evidence-receipt descendant while preserving the reviewed semantic source and rejecting every other delta.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Occupied cleanup must be bound to this tranche's exact attempt root name and parent and must be exercised before launch.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first controller delegated cleanup to a predecessor helper whose hard-coded exact attempt name differed from this tranche.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: A preexecution cleanup rehearsal returned attempt_cleanup_scope_invalid before any occupied process or provider request.

correction.action: Implement a local exact-name and exact-parent cleanup guard and test successful removal plus wrong-name rejection.
correction.prevention_control: Every occupied controller must own or parameterize its cleanup identity and execute a real disposable removal test before launch.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: replaces a foreign hard-coded cleanup identity with a tranche-owned exact containment and removal test.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The persisted checkpoint loader must validate every exact field emitted by checkpoint admission before attempt consumption.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first expected object omitted the newly emitted checkpoint_source field and would have rejected the admitted checkpoint before native launch.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: A new persisted-checkpoint test failed before attempt consumption and provider execution.

correction.action: Revalidate checkpoint ancestry and include checkpoint_source in the exact persisted object expectation.
correction.prevention_control: Every prepared and checkpoint artifact must have a persisted round-trip test before its consuming action becomes callable.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: adds persisted checkpoint round-trip validation before attempt consumption.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The process-absence reading must count only the owned Node runtime class and must not match the observer command containing its search literals.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first generic command-line query reported one match because it counted its own pwsh.exe command.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Process identity readback showed the sole match was PowerShell; an exact node.exe-filtered query returned zero.

correction.action: Filter the read-only query to node.exe before applying the exact attempt and broker command-line predicates.
correction.prevention_control: Owned-process absence queries must type the executable class independently of command-line search literals and report only that closed class.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: corrects a self-matching process query and binds absence to the owned Node executable class.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: One provider response selecting the admitted direct edit must yield an accepted edit result, immediate concluded turn, exact changed path and schema-valid candidate without a second request.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The consumed turn recorded one edit call and result but no changed path or conclusion, ended with turn_kind error, and reached a contained later-request rejection after its one completed provider request.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The typed runner, broker, candidate and cleanup coordinates in the immutable occupied terminal established the exact failed-closed sequence.

correction.action: Consume the attempt without retry, reject candidate adoption, preserve only typed evidence and route a provider-free diagnostic successor.
correction.prevention_control: Before any later occupied successor, reproduce the exact post-execute variants provider-free and emit a closed edit-result, decision and conclusion coordinate in the terminal.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the one-request edit-result/conclusion failure as Harness evidence and routes only provider-free diagnosis.

agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first closeout intent carried two builds_on relationships and was rejected as node_relationship_invalid.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork semantic check rejected the transaction manifest before command execution, generation publication or canonical mutation.

correction.action: Retain only the immediate accepted Harness predecessor as the single builds_on parent.
correction.prevention_control: Construct closeout relationships through the transaction schema's exact one-parent builder rather than an open list.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the rejected two-parent closeout and restores the exact one-immediate-parent invariant.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The live Baton acceptance projection must use the manifest-listed Current DeepSeek native Harness acceptance rolling slot.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The second closeout intent invented a descriptive failed-closed acceptance label and the compaction guard rejected it as unindexed.

correction.action: Use the exact manifest-listed rolling acceptance label and retain result semantics in schema-owned node and closeout fields.
correction.prevention_control: Select Baton acceptance labels only from the compaction manifest's active_labels vocabulary before clockwork invocation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the rejected descriptive label and restores the closed current native-Harness rolling slot.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The compact live Baton rolling acceptance row must remain below the fixed byte budget while the complete evidence inventory remains available in Continuity.

correction.action: Reduce the rolling acceptance row to eight controlling artifacts and retain the complete inventory in the Continuity node and closeout intent.
correction.prevention_control: Precompute the prospective Baton byte count and generate compact rolling acceptance paths from controlling roles rather than copying the full evidence inventory.
